mentions.heading: Operations carried out by joint ventures in China, Korea and battery sourcing
mentions.risk_name: Joint venture partner and control risk
mentions.detail: Major operations in China and Korea via JVs; China JV agreement expires 2027, renegotiation ongoing; battery and raw material JVs in U.S./Canada
mentions.quote: Our primary joint venture agreement for our China JVs expires in 2027, and we are in negotiations with our partner for a new agreement.

mentions.heading: Limited control over joint venture actions and compliance
mentions.risk_name: Joint venture compliance and misconduct exposure
mentions.detail: Minority interests limit control; JVs may not follow GM governance, reporting or compliance; potential fines and reputational harm
mentions.quote: As a result, we may be unable to prevent violations of applicable laws or other misconduct by a joint venture, adverse human rights or other impacts, or the failure to satisfy contractual obligations by one or more parties.

mentions.heading: The international scale and footprint of our operations expose us to additional risks
mentions.detail: Tensions between China and U.S. may restrict dividend repatriation and technology exports
mentions.quote: (5) political and economic tensions between governments and changes in international economic policies, including restrictions on the repatriation of dividends or in the export of technology, especially between China and the U.S.;

mentions.heading: Tariffs and trade barriers on global operations
mentions.risk_name: Import tariffs and trade barrier costs
mentions.detail: New or higher tariffs on products imported into or exported from the U.S.; free trade agreement changes; integrated global supply chain
mentions.quote: (6) changes to customs requirements or procedures (e.g., inspections) or new or higher tariffs, for example, on products imported into or exported from the U.S., including under U.S. or other trade laws or measures, or other key markets;

mentions.heading: Differing local product and certification requirements
mentions.risk_name: Divergent vehicle emissions and EV regulations
mentions.detail: Government certification on fuel economy, emissions, EVs, AVs, connected services and safety varies by country
mentions.quote: (10) differing local product preferences and product requirements, including government certification requirements related to, among other things, fuel economy, vehicle emissions, EVs and AVs, connected services, and safety;

mentions.heading: Export controls, sanctions and anti-corruption laws
mentions.detail: Exposure to U.S. and foreign export controls, sanctions, foreign investment rules and FCPA
mentions.quote: (12) impacts on our operations or liabilities resulting from U.S. and foreign laws and regulations, including, but not limited to, those related to the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and certain other anti-corruption laws;

mentions.heading: Currency, macroeconomic and catastrophic event risks abroad
mentions.quote: (8) changes in foreign currency exchange rates and interest rates; (9) economic downturns or significant changes in macroeconomic conditions in the countries in which we operate;
